subject: A big invitation to talk, a small chair to sit on
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: at right, Akhilesh Yadav, in a red cap, a white kurta-pyjama and a dark blue sleeveless vest, sits in a large wooden armchair and holds out his right hand towards a small, empty wooden chair placed in front of him. At the lower left, seen from behind and in profile, Rahul Gandhi, in a white shirt, with wavy hair and a grey-streaked beard, looks up at him. A speech balloon at the upper left reads: ‘COME, LET'S TALK!’. The signature ‘SATISH ACHARYA’ is at the lower right.
chutki: Seated in the big chair, Akhilesh Yadav reaches a hand towards the small empty chair and says: ‘Come, let's talk!’; Rahul Gandhi, standing below, looks up at him.
The needle: in any alliance the size of the chair is the whole conversation. The invitation is broad, the seat on offer is small, and who gets how much room is still to be settled.
